name: Kirchhoff and Bunsen’s spectral chemical analysis
description: Identification of elements using characteristic spectral lines.

impact.note: Let chemists and astronomers identify elements by their light, even in stars; spectrochemical analysis and astrophysics grew from it. Generativity could be argued higher.

date.basis: Year of the historical document; work may have begun earlier.

events.statement: Kirchhoff and Bunsen described qualitative chemical analysis using characteristic bright spectral lines, focusing on alkali and alkaline-earth metals.
